why_trail.why: The binding store has three writers (claim, release, SessionStart) but each currently performs an unlocked load-modify-save; absolute claims bypass checklist validation, rail and gauge use different identity predicates, and current readers consume whatever remains. The frozen handoff resolves these at one rail-owned transaction seam while preserving reader fail-open behavior and lifecycle semantics.

Portable binding transaction implemented in spine_rail.py: stable sibling lock (.spine-rail-binding.json.lock), POSIX flock / Windows msvcrt byte-range adapters (injectable for cross-platform unit testing), bounded retry (LOCK_RETRY_ATTEMPTS=200, LOCK_RETRY_INTERVAL_SECONDS=0.01, LOCK_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=2.0), unique-temp atomic replace via tempfile.mkstemp+os.replace with best-effort cleanup. All three writers (claim, release, SessionStart bind-on-resume) now route through _binding_transaction. Five new named tests (contention/timeout/api-failure/replace-failure/windows-adapter) plus the pre-existing spawn red/green test all pass; spawn red/green re-verified GREEN 3x consecutively, 16/16 entries retained.

is_usable_agent_id is the sole 1-64 ASCII alnum/_/- allowlist predicate in spine_rail.py; binding_key() and gauge_writer_hook's _is_usable_agent_id both delegate to it (gauge's local _AGENT_ID_ALLOWED regex removed). _is_valid_claim_target() requires _worktree_from_spine containment shape + looks_like_checklist readability + a resolve()-based symlink-escape re-check, applied to both absolute and relative claim resolution and re-checked inside the locked mutator. _reap_binding_entries() runs inside every _binding_transaction before the mutation: drops malformed entries/empty per-key maps and released-lease entries immediately, drops missing-target entries only past a 24h aware-timestamp grace, retains every readable non-released target regardless of age and every missing target with untrustworthy age, passes old-shape per-key values through untouched. Release still resolves the recorded target first against the LOCKED reaped snapshot before falling back to the filesystem ladder. New focused tests: test_reap_binding_entries_matrix (full reaper matrix with injected now), test_reap_binding_entries_never_raises_and_keeps_data_on_error, test_post_claim_symlink_escape_target_binds_nothing, test_rail_and_gauge_agree_on_every_id_in_the_shared_table (replaces the now-obsolete rail-vs-gauge divergence test), plus two absolute-claim tests updated for target validation.
